name: dev-skills
description: Structured AI workflows for software development. 60 domain-specific skills and 27 chained workflows across 8 developer plugins — from code quality to architecture, testing, debugging, and DevOps.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Developer utility skills: Git workflows, commit messages, PR templates, code generation, regex building, and SQL query optimization.

plugins.name: dev-code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality skills: code review, refactoring, clean code, naming conventions, complexity analysis, code smell detection, and performance review.

plugins.name: dev-testing
plugins.description: Testing skills: test strategy, unit/integration/E2E test design, TDD guidance, test coverage analysis, mock strategies, and test data generation.

plugins.name: dev-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture skills: system design, ADR creation, design patterns, API design, database schema, microservices, scalability analysis, and C4 diagrams.

plugins.name: dev-debugging
plugins.description: Debugging skills: root cause analysis, log analysis, stack trace analysis, performance profiling, memory leak detection, and incident postmortems.

plugins.name: dev-documentation
plugins.description: Documentation skills: README generation, API documentation, code comments, changelog generation, technical specs, runbooks, and onboarding guides.

plugins.name: dev-devops
plugins.description: DevOps skills: CI/CD pipeline design, Dockerfile optimization, Kubernetes manifests, IaC, deployment strategies, monitoring, SRE principles, and cost optimization.

plugins.name: dev-security
plugins.description: Security skills: security code review, threat modeling, dependency audits, authentication design, secure coding, secrets management, and penetration test planning.
